summary: Conviction under Sections 363, 366 IPC set aside; benefit of doubt due to inconsistent medical age opinions and prosecutrix's voluntary conduct; travel, marriage registration, and cohabitation with appellant held consensual; no 'taking' or 'enticing' proven; acquittal warranted; reliance on S. Vardarajan v. State of Madras.
legal_provisions_cited: S. Vardarajan v. State of Madras
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction under Sections 363 and 366 IPC set aside; appellant acquitted; impugned High Court judgment set aside.
